config.hypothesis: This is the reference arm for the matched 12000-step data_seed 1 test. m2 is fixed at 0.5 and data_seed is 1. N=64 seeds 20-21 (4 layers, d_model=64, e in [0, 0.5], best-of-3 controls) are trained to 12000 steps and keep force above control. Their final trained force R2 is at least 0.04 above the same seed's 12000-step N=128 value from the paired arm proposed in this cycle. Values are read from probes_final at the best-margin layer, unrounded, and the layer is reported. Cross-layer comparisons are flagged. Within-run values are read as that layer's control plus margin, never from the max-over-layers trajectory field. If the paired N=128 run is unavailable, the comparison is reported as not computed. Horizon check: step-6000 trained force R2 must be within 0.03 of the 6000-step N=64 data_seed 1 runs (0.7792 seed 20, 0.8376 seed 21). Otherwise the comparison is reported as horizon-confounded.
